title: Closure of Polynomial Time Under Complement
statement: Let $p$ be a predicate on finite binary strings. If the language $\\{z : p(z)\\}$ belongs to $\\mathsf{P}$, then its complement language $\\{z : \\neg p(z)\\}$ also belongs to $\\mathsf{P}$.
hypotheses_covered: The language defined by $p$ belongs to $\\mathsf{P}$
